_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the @thearchv.ai Instagram carousel. Nothing here is repeated anywhere else: build.mjs generates every CSS rule below from this file, so a value changed here is changed everywhere. Same discipline as match-covers/carousel/tokens.json. Adopted by founder ruling 2026-08-04, which killed the washed-slate panel format (#1A3645 box on #162C38) that shipped on 2026-08-03.
_migration: PALETTE MIGRATED 2026-08-14. This file previously hardcoded the RETIRED navy/gold/cream (bg #071C2B, panel #0C2A3E, fg #F2EAD3, accent #C9A14A) — the legacy palette that BRAND-COLORS.md / brand-colors.json retired for new renders on 2026-08-09 (D-2026-08-09b) and whose bg #071C2B was never a registered brand colour at all (a stray fourth navy, now removed). The colour block below now maps to brand-colors.json pair 10 'Archive Navy / Cream' (MAIN role): pair dark #1E223D as ground, pair light #F2EAD3 as type, and the pair's registered third #FA6A3C ('Signal Orange Bright') as accent. AUTHORITY: brand-colors.json. NOTE the chrome._comment prose below still says 'GOLD' descriptively — that is historical commentary; the rendered accent is now orange. JUDGMENT CALLS PENDING FOUNDER: (1) pair 10 was chosen as the least-disruptive MAIN pair (keeps the deck's navy-ground/cream-type look, body-safe at 12.9:1); confirm or pick another. (2) 'panel' #2A2F54 and 'dim' #B7AE95 are DERIVED for this pair (a raised navy + a dimmed cream), not canon values — confirm. (3) Decide whether this deck should read a rotating pair from brand-colors.json per render (rotation rules 2/3) rather than hardcoding one pair.

canvas._comment: 4:5, the Instagram carousel ceiling. Rendered at deviceScaleFactor 2 from a 1080x1350 CSS box.

colour._comment: Pair 10 'Archive Navy / Cream' (brand-colors.json), migrated 2026-08-14 off the retired navy/gold/cream — see _migration at top. panel is a RAISED SURFACE ONLY. It is never a container the headline sits inside. A card whose main content is a box on a background is the dead format and is refused.

type._comment: Anton is the whole look: the type IS the design. Archivo carries body copy and chrome. Loaded from Google Fonts at build time; render.mjs waits on document.fonts.ready.

scale._comment: Headline sizes in CSS px at 1080 wide. xl/lg/md picked per slide in the content JSON. The headline must fill most of the frame; if a slide looks empty, the headline is too small or the copy is too thin.

chrome._comment: Every slide carries the same four marks so four images read as one object. kicker_default is the weekly build-log lane; the daily news lane may substitute its own word (founder 2026-08-04) and everything else in the system still holds.
chrome._swipe_comment: Founder instruction 2026-08-05: 'for all carousels, add an arrow at the bottom right telling people to swipe.' This deck already carried the word; what changed that night is that it is now GOLD (accent) rather than cream, matching the cue shipped in match-covers/carousel/build_chrome.py, and that the LAST SLIDE CARRIES NOTHING in that position. The old swipe_final of 'FOLLOW ->' was an arrow on the one slide with nowhere to swipe to, and slide 4 already ends on the gold FOLLOW @THEARCHV.AI block, so the arrow was pointing at a CTA that was directly above it. The key is deliberately gone rather than emptied: build.mjs draws the cue on non-final slides only and does not read a final-slide value, so a key here would be dead weight that a later edit could wrongly rewire.
chrome.chip: big numeral over OF NN, gold-outlined rounded box, top right

hard_rules.slide_count: FOUR slides per story. Canon D-2026-08-04l. Hook, evidence with named sources, the turn for someone building, CTA.
hard_rules.type_led: The headline fills most of the frame and is the design. No panel box holding a small centred sentence in an otherwise empty card.
hard_rules.source_on_slide: Every number carries its named source on the slide it appears on. No number ships without one. This does not relax for a restyle.
hard_rules.language: British English, full entity names, no em dashes. First person is permitted on this account.
hard_rules.overflow: GUARDED. render.mjs measures every slide and refuses to write PNGs when content exceeds the frame. An overflow is a rewrite, never a truncation.
hard_rules.read_back: Every rendered slide is opened as an image and looked at before it is queued. A build log saying DONE is not evidence.
